# Esteban Dalel R — Personal Tools Site

> A collection of small, browser-based utilities built by Esteban Dalel R.
> All tools run entirely client-side with no data sent to any server.

## Tools

- [Image Converter](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/imageConverter): Convert images between PNG, JPG, and WebP formats. Apply black & white or duotone (recolorize) effects. Split images into configurable grid pieces.
- [Image Trace](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/imageTrace): Convert images to edge-traced outlines using Sobel edge detection. Optimized for laser etching.
- [Paint by Numbers](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/paintByNumbers): Generate a paint-by-numbers worksheet from any image using k-means color quantization.
- [Embroidery Tracer](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/embroideryTracer): Generate SVG paths from images for embroidery patterns. Outputs color trace, monochrome trace, and line art.
- [Video Converter](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/videoConverter): Convert video files between AVI, MP4, MOV, WebM, and MKV using FFmpeg in the browser.
- [Stop Motion Editor](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/videoEditor): Upload a sequence of images and export a stop motion animation video.
- [QR Code Generator](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/qr): Create custom QR codes from any text or URL with configurable colors and error correction.
- [Character Count](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/characterCount): Analyze text for character, word, and sentence statistics.
- [Text Diff](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/textDiff): Compare two text blocks side-by-side with highlighted differences.
- [ASL Learning](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/asl): Learn the American Sign Language alphabet and numbers with interactive flashcards.
- [Braille](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/braille): Interactive Braille alphabet learning tool.
- [Cursive](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/cursive): Practice cursive handwriting with letter and word guides.
- [Morse Code](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/morse): Learn, practice, and decode Morse code.
- [Piano](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/piano): Interactive piano keyboard with chords and melodies.
- [Swedish Learning](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/swedish): Swedish vocabulary flashcards and quizzes.
- [Portuguese Learning](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/portuguese): Portuguese vocabulary, verb conjugation, and common phrases.
- [Merge PDF](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/mergePdf): Combine multiple PDF files into a single document. Drag-and-drop with reorder support.
- [Split PDF](https://www.estebandalelr.co/tools/splitPdf): Extract page ranges, individual pages, or odd/even pages from a PDF.

## Other Pages

- [Group Expenses](https://www.estebandalelr.co/money): Split group expenses and calculate settlements between participants.
- [Deep Connection](https://www.estebandalelr.co/deep): A relationship card game with tiered conversation questions.

## About

Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
All image and video processing happens in the browser using the Canvas API and WebAssembly (FFmpeg).
No backend, no data collection.

## Battery Masters

- [Battery Masters](https://www.estebandalelr.co/batteries): Narrated, scroll-driven exam explainers for the batteries & energy storage courses.
- [Energy in Society & Energy Storage](https://www.estebandalelr.co/batteries/introduction/energy-storage)
- [Electric Circuits & the Grid](https://www.estebandalelr.co/batteries/introduction/electric-circuits)
- [Materials Chemistry](https://www.estebandalelr.co/batteries/materials)
- [Applied Electrochemistry](https://www.estebandalelr.co/batteries/electrochemistry)
- [Programme Map](https://www.estebandalelr.co/batteries/programme): The TBT2M Battery Technology & Energy Storage master programme by semester and track, with prerequisites and a progress tracker.
- [Phase Diagram Explorer](https://www.estebandalelr.co/batteries/phase-diagrams): Cu–Ni, Pb–Sn and Fe–Fe₃C phase diagrams with live tie lines and the lever rule.
- [Metallography Lab](https://www.estebandalelr.co/batteries/metallography): Pre-lab quiz practice for the Materials Chemistry metallography lab, with Fe–C point picking and a lab cheat sheet.
- [Interstitial Sites](https://www.estebandalelr.co/batteries/interstitial-sites): Octahedral, tetrahedral and cubic sites in SC, FCC, BCC and HCP lattices, in 3D.
- [Electrochemistry Lab](https://www.estebandalelr.co/batteries/electrochem-lab): Simulated cyclic voltammetry, chronoamperometry and chronopotentiometry with Randles–Ševčík, Cottrell and Sand readouts.
- [Energy Storage Types](https://www.estebandalelr.co/batteries/energy-storage-types): Compare storage technologies by energy density, power density, efficiency and duration.
- [Kirchhoff Lab](https://www.estebandalelr.co/batteries/kirchhoff): Solve circuits by hand, then check them against a live simulation.
